scope: Read-only audit of default game typography before period-face replacement; legacy prototype and documentation identified separately.
defaultEntry: dist/index.html -> native-shell.css -> screen.css; native-host.mjs uses painted-ui.mjs

roles: Observed native glyphs/runs including menus, save/load, advisor speech, help list and reports
Semantic HUD, factory and advisor buttons
House confirmation question and house name
canvasTextEntryPoints.recommendation: Replace single text measurement/draw boundary consistently; retain literal native captions, immutable source advances, stable whole-run layout, strict clipping and existing six-column credit geometry.

secondarySurfaces.status: Legacy alternate game, not default compiled-native route
Documentation/gallery/source pages use separate DOM heading/body styling; do not confuse their typography with native game captions

recommendations.role: Default buttons, gameplay labels, normal dialogue
recommendations.style: Angular proportional Westwood sans; preserve square counters, clipped diagonals and original uppercase/lowercase relationships. Avoid synthetic bold and system fallback.
recommendations.size: Fit foreground ink within existing content rectangle; ordinary native font box11px, visibly painted caps about7px. Keep current semantic button padding and fit the whole literal label.

recommendations.style: Compact8px box, uppercase forms even for lowercase source; use only where original font1 is observed or needed for narrow tiny UI.
recommendations.size: Preserve original font1 geometry/advances and original line heights. Do not force ALL dialogue into compact all-caps.

recommendations.style: Original19px face has deliberately old Roman/pointed flourishes. Its period character differs from modern Georgia; avoid using its broad proportions as the blanket UI body face.
recommendations.size: Keep title image and native cinematic ownership; use explicit title roles rather than font0 automatically selecting Georgia.

recommendations.style: Retain each native column and leading blanks; no proportional digit recentering or tracking between six slots.
recommendations.size: Use CREDIT_COUNTER safe field and existing clipping/y motion.

fidelityChecks: Whole caption unchanged by cursor occlusion
Deterministic per-string metrics; cursor positions must not change scale or spacing
Six rolling columns stay inside safe interior for all carry offsets
Zero text-fit violations for long menus/house names and all observed font roles
No original UI strings or native command positions changed merely to fit new face
